name: Income Certificate
how_to_obtain: Apply through your State e-District portal or visit your local CSC / Tehsildar office with salary slips, ITR, or Gram Panchayat self-declaration. Processing typically takes 5 to 10 working days.
common_rejection_reasons: Expired financial year certificate, missing QR/digital signature, or certificate issued in parent's name without student relation mentioned.

name: Caste / Category Certificate
issuing_authority: District Magistrate / Sub-Divisional Officer / Revenue Circle Officer
validity: Permanent for SC/ST; OBC Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) requires annual renewal
how_to_obtain: Submit family lineage proof, father's caste certificate, and residential proof on the state e-District portal.
common_rejection_reasons: Submitting State list certificate for Central Govt quota, or submitting Creamy Layer status for OBC reserved seats.

name: Bonafide Student Certificate
issuing_authority: College / University Registrar or School Principal
how_to_obtain: Request from the College Academic Section or Student Welfare Office with your current year fee receipt and college ID card.
common_rejection_reasons: Missing official institute seal, outdated academic session, or unsigned by the authorized signatory.
mandatory_for: Almost all government and private scholarships

name: Aadhaar Card (Linked with Mobile & Bank)
how_to_obtain: Visit UIDAI enrollment center or download e-Aadhaar from uidai.gov.in using Aadhaar OTP.
common_rejection_reasons: Bank account not NPCI/Aadhaar seeded (causes DBT failure), or mismatched spelling of student name with marksheet.

name: Previous Qualifying Marksheets (10th / 12th / Semester)
issuing_authority: State Board / CBSE / ICSE / Respective University
how_to_obtain: Original mark sheet from school/college or DigiLocker certified digital copy.
common_rejection_reasons: Blurry scans, submitting provisional web results without college attestation, or cut-off corners.

name: Bank Account Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
how_to_obtain: Download latest computerized bank statement or scan the first page of your passbook showing account number and IFSC code.
common_rejection_reasons: Submitting minor/joint account with parents without proper permission, or account dormant due to inactivity.

name: Single Girl Child Affidavit
issuing_authority: First Class Judicial Magistrate / Notary Public on ₹100 Stamp Paper
how_to_obtain: Draft affidavit stating that the applicant is the only girl child or only two girl children in the family, sworn before a notary public.
common_rejection_reasons: Unnotarized plain paper declaration or missing parental signature.

name: Disability Certificate (PwD)
issuing_authority: District Medical Board / Chief Medical Officer (CMO)
validity: Permanent (or as stated for temporary impairment)
how_to_obtain: Obtain UDID card online via swavlambancard.gov.in after assessment by authorized government medical board.
common_rejection_reasons: Disability percentage less than 40%, or expired temporary disability certificate.
